title: Bundled Chocolatey CLI
sub: The Chocolatey CLI built from this repository ships inside the app, so there is nothing to install before the first command.

title: Command schema generated from the CLI source
sub: Every command, option, config setting and feature the app offers is read from the C# source of the CLI in this repository, not typed in by hand.

title: Console
sub: One page that offers every Chocolatey command with every one of its options, as a form.

title: Command preview and dry run
sub: Every form shows the exact command before it runs, and the option dialogs can run it as a dry run first.

title: Installed packages
sub: A list of the packages on each machine, with status, single actions, bulk actions, and packages.config export and import.

title: Discover and install
sub: Search the package sources of a machine and install from the results, with a single click or with every install option.

title: Updates
sub: What is out of date on each machine, and one button to upgrade it all.

title: Sources
sub: The package sources of each machine, with a switch to enable or disable each one.

title: Config and features
sub: Every Chocolatey config setting and every feature switch, per machine, with the description from the CLI source.

title: Pins
sub: Hold a package at its current version so that upgrades skip it.

title: API keys
sub: See which sources have a stored API key on a machine, add one, or remove one, without the key value ever being shown.

title: Cache, templates, rules, licence and support
sub: A page of small readers for the remaining CLI commands.

title: Package builder
sub: Forms for the commands that create and publish packages: new, pack, push and export.

title: Bulk actions and exports
sub: Tick several rows and act on all of them, or export a list as CSV, JSON or Markdown.

title: Hub
sub: A web app that manages many Windows machines from one place.

title: Hub container image
sub: The hub as a container image with a volume for its data, a health check and a non-root user.

title: Sign in
sub: Sign in to the hub with a password or a passkey, with lockout after failures, and sessions that expire.

title: Passkeys
sub: Sign in to the hub with a fingerprint, a face, a device PIN or a security key.

title: Users and roles
sub: More than one person can sign in to a hub, each with a role: admin, operator or viewer.

title: Pairing
sub: A one time code joins a Windows machine to a hub.

title: Remote agent
sub: The part of the app that connects a Windows machine to a hub, runs the jobs it is given, and streams the output back.

title: Read only agents
sub: A machine can be paired so that it reports everything and changes nothing.

title: Command allow lists
sub: Limit a machine to a chosen set of Chocolatey commands, enforced by the hub and, when set on the machine, by the agent itself.

title: Machine selection and groups
sub: Choose which machines the pages show and act on, and label machines with groups.

title: Jobs and live output
sub: Every command becomes a job with a state, live output, an exit code and a log you can export.

title: Offline job queue
sub: A command for a machine that is switched off waits for it, for up to 7 days.

title: Schedules
sub: Run a command every day, or on chosen days of the week, on all machines, a group, or a chosen set.

title: History
sub: An append-only record of who did what on the hub, with export.

title: Status webhooks
sub: The hub posts a short message to an address of your choice when a job fails, a machine stays offline, or sign in is locked out.

title: Secret masking
sub: Source passwords and API keys are replaced with ******** wherever a command is recorded or displayed.

title: Secrets at rest
sub: The hub encrypts the secret values it has to keep on disk, and is plain about what that does and does not protect.

title: Hub HTTP API
sub: The JSON API that the interface and the agents use, documented with a Postman collection.

title: Two key confirmation
sub: Destructive actions need two separate keys and then a slider before they run.

title: Install result takeovers
sub: Every install or upgrade that finishes takes over the screen: a celebration on success, an alarm with the exit code and the last output on failure.

title: Notifications
sub: Short messages that do not block your work, and a list of them behind the bell.

title: Loading, empty, offline and error states
sub: Every page says what is actually true: loading, nothing here yet, offline, or failed and why.

title: Overview
sub: The first page: what needs attention across the selected machines, and one button to upgrade everything.

title: First-run wizard
sub: A four step setup that does real work on the first start, and can be skipped.

title: Command palette
sub: Press Ctrl+Shift+F anywhere to search every page, command and setting, and act on the result.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
sub: One list of shortcuts that the key handler, the menus, the command palette and the Help page all read, so a shortcut that is shown is the shortcut that works.

title: Tabs
sub: Every page is a tab in a strip on the left.

title: Context menus with a filter
sub: Right click anything for its actions.

title: Filters and regex
sub: A foldable filter bar on every list, with plain text by default and regular expressions on request.

title: Pattern builder
sub: Describe the text you are looking for, and the builder writes the regular expression.

title: Settings that explain themselves
sub: Each setting says what it does and whether its value is the built-in default, and can be reset on its own.

title: Changelog viewer
sub: The changes of each version, inside the app, with a filter and an export.

title: Help page
sub: Help that works offline: short articles, the keyboard shortcuts, and the help text of every Chocolatey command.

title: Phone layout
sub: The hub's interface works at phone width, so you can check on machines and start an upgrade from a phone.

title: Base64 tools
sub: Turn text or a file into Base64 and back, entirely in the browser.

title: Language modes
sub: English, Hong Kong Cantonese, or both at once, with a separate tone setting for each language.

title: Personal wording file
sub: Load a JSON file that replaces words in the interface with your own, kept on your device.

title: School mode
sub: A plain mode for shared or public screens: English only, no playful options, with an optional PIN.

title: Theme and seed colour
sub: Light and dark themes, both derived from one seed colour that you can change.

title: Custom logo and presets
sub: Put your own mark in the top bar, and apply a named set of appearance settings with one click and an undo.

title: Timed settings
sub: Let settings switch by the clock: a dark theme in the evening, quieter results at night.

title: Accessibility tools
sub: Text size, contrast, motion, target size and focus ring, one click from every page.

title: Sound and narration
sub: Short action sounds, and an optional voice that reads job results aloud.

title: Focus modes
sub: Five separate switches that reduce what is on screen or add gentle structure.

title: Desktop app
sub: A Windows app that manages Chocolatey on the PC it runs on, and can also connect that PC to a hub.

title: Windows installer
sub: A Squirrel.Windows Setup.exe, built by the release workflow with the repository's own Chocolatey CLI inside.

title: Version and build time
sub: The version and the build time of the running copy are on the first screen and on every page.
